sources.title: Official NIHK notice index: 2023-11-23 Goryeosa original-image LINK change
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History / 한국사데이터베이스
sources.quality_notes: Official notice index displays item 50 dated 2023-11-23 titled '고려사 원문이미지 LINK 변경 안내'. The notice body, previous and updated destinations, any source-copy and article-specific provenance NOT obtained; no inference that any GK03539/3579, GK05553 or NIKH KO21634 copy was switched. This is a 2023 digital link event, not ancient image-content proof.

sources.title: Official NIHK 2026-01-29 2025 DB uploads: Goryeosa Jeolyo images linked to SNU
sources.provider: National Institute of Korean History / 한국사데이터베이스
sources.quality_notes: The notice dated 2026-01-29 lists 고려사절요 : 서울대 규장각한국학연구원 원문이미지 연계, a separate work Goryeosa Jeolyo. Cannot treat the Goryeosa Jeolyo linkage as Goryeosa 卷52 original-image identity. Compare 2025-02-04 prior notice that separately mentions 고려사 only; neither proves specific target original leaf or glyph.
